camel_example: aliyun eci TagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'eci-2zelg8vwnlzdhf8hv0000' --Tag.1.Key testkey --Tag.1.Value testvalue --ResourceType ContainerGroup --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: The TagResources operation attaches tags to specified ECI resources
description_zh: 调用TagResources为指定的ECI资源绑定标签
kebab_example: aliyun eci tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-id eci-2zelg8vwnlzdhf8hv0000 --tag Value=testvalue Key=testkey --resource-type ContainerGroup --region cn-hangzhou
name: TagResources

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the resource is located
parameters.name: region_id

fields.help_en: The key of the tag. The key cannot be an empty string. The key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and it cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持 128 个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the tag. The value can be an empty string. The value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and it cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签键。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持 128 个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The list of tags. You can attach a maximum of 20 tags to a resource
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表。一个资源最多可以绑定20个标签
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource. Valid values:

ContainerGroup: ECI instance

ImageCache: image cache

DataCache: data cache

VirtualNode: virtual node
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。取值范围：

ContainerGroup：ECI实例
ImageCache：镜像缓存
DataCache：数据缓存
VirtualNode：虚拟节点
parameters.name: resource_type
